summary: Early binding builds the enrollment endpoint and a shared long-lived certificate into the image, tying devices to one service; late binding injects device-specific short-lived certificates at provisioning via cloud-init, Ignition or kickstart. The enrollment cert only secures the request; enrolled devices use management certificates.
questions: What is the difference between early and late binding in Edge Manager?
How do I inject the enrollment certificate at provisioning time?
Is the enrollment certificate used after a device is enrolled?
